title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
description: Explore the unique rituals and annual celebrations that define the Blue Demon spirit at DePaul University, from late-night finals breakfasts to the legacy of St. Vincent de Paul.

cards.title: DePaul Duck Day
cards.subtitle: Loop Campus Tradition
cards.notes: Visit the Loop Campus each quarter to pick a rubber duck from a pool for prizes. You get to keep your themed duck as a collectible memento of student life.
cards.short_summary: A quarterly event at the Loop Campus where students win prizes by picking rubber ducks from a pool.
cards.evidence_claim: DePaul Duck Day occurs every quarter at the Loop Campus; students pick a rubber duck to win prizes and keep the duck.
cards.source_title: My Favorite DePaul Traditions Ranked | DeBlogs
cards.access_notes: Held quarterly at the Loop Campus; check DeHUB for specific dates and times.

cards.title: Midnight Breakfast
cards.subtitle: Finals Week Study Break
cards.notes: Head to the Lincoln Park Student Center during fall finals week for free pancakes served by university administrators. It is a high-energy late-night break from studying.
cards.short_summary: A free late-night breakfast served by faculty and staff to students during fall quarter finals week.
cards.evidence_claim: Midnight Breakfast is a free event for students held during Fall Quarter finals where faculty and staff serve breakfast.
cards.source_title: 9th Annual Finals Breakfast | Events | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Typically held from 8:30 PM to 11:30 PM on a Tuesday during fall finals week.

cards.title: Vinny Fest
cards.subtitle: St. Vincent de Paul Feast Day
cards.notes: Celebrate the university's namesake on the Lincoln Park Quad with snacks, games, and activities that connect students to the Vincentian mission and history.
cards.short_summary: An annual festival on the Quad celebrating St. Vincent de Paul's feast day with interactive booths and snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Vinny Fest is a yearly celebration on the Quad held to commemorate St. Vincent de Paul's feast day on September 27.
cards.source_title: DePaul celebrates St. Vincent's Feast Day - The DePaulia
cards.access_notes: Held annually around September 27 on the Lincoln Park Campus Quad.

cards.title: Ugly Sweater Party
cards.subtitle: Holiday Kick-off Event
cards.notes: Join thousands of students on the Quad to snag a limited-edition DePaul ugly sweater. Enjoy holiday snacks and crafts before the official tree lighting ceremony.
cards.short_summary: A massive student gathering on the Lincoln Park Quad featuring holiday crafts and free themed ugly sweaters.
cards.evidence_claim: The Ugly Sweater Party brings together thousands of students for holiday snacks, crafts, and DePaul ugly sweaters.
cards.source_title: Ugly Sweater Party and Tree Lighting | Events | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Held on a Friday afternoon in mid-November; sweaters are limited and distributed on a first-come basis.

cards.title: Tree Lighting Ceremony
cards.subtitle: St. Vincent's Circle Tradition
cards.notes: Gather at St. Vincent's Circle to watch the holiday tree illuminate for the season. The event features caroling, hot chocolate, and remarks from the university president.
cards.short_summary: The official lighting of the holiday tree at St. Vincent's Circle, marking the start of the winter season.
cards.evidence_claim: DePaul hosts its annual Tree Lighting Ceremony at St. Vincent's Circle to kick off the winter holiday season.
cards.source_title: Tree Lighting Ceremony at DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Typically held on a Monday evening in mid-November at St. Vincent's Circle.

cards.title: Blue Demon Week
cards.subtitle: Winter Spirit Celebration
cards.notes: Participate in a week of school spirit events, including the Blue Demon Challenge and the Pasta Dinner, culminating in a major home basketball game.
cards.short_summary: A week-long celebration of DePaul spirit featuring community events, athletics, and fundraising challenges.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Demon Week brings together students, faculty, and alumni for events like the Pasta Dinner and basketball games.
cards.source_title: Campus Traditions for Students - DePaul University Alumni
cards.access_notes: Held annually during the winter quarter; specific event locations vary across both campuses.

cards.title: Blue Demon Challenge
cards.subtitle: Annual Day of Giving
cards.notes: Join the university-wide effort to support student scholarships and programs. Look for matching challenges and social media blitzes throughout this 24-hour event.
cards.short_summary: DePaul's annual 24-hour fundraising event where the community gives back to support university programs.
cards.evidence_claim: Blue Demon Challenge is DePaul's annual day of giving, featuring matching opportunities to support scholarships and athletics.
cards.source_title: Blue Demon Challenge is here | DePaul University
cards.access_notes: Occurs annually in late January; participation is primarily online via the challenge website.

cards.title: FEST
cards.subtitle: Spring Music Festival
cards.notes: Celebrate the end of the academic year with a major outdoor concert on the Lincoln Park Quad. Past performers have included top-tier national touring artists.
cards.short_summary: A student-run music festival held on the Lincoln Park Quad every May to celebrate the end of the year.
cards.evidence_claim: FEST is a student-run music event hosted by the DePaul Activities Board on the Lincoln Park Campus Quad each May.
cards.source_title: DePaul Traditions | Division of Student Affairs
cards.access_notes: Held in late May; requires a student ticket for entry.

cards.title: Loop Cookie Stroll
cards.subtitle: Downtown Holiday Scavenger Hunt
cards.notes: Explore the Loop Campus by visiting different offices to collect cookies and participate in small holiday crafts like pin-making or card-writing.
cards.short_summary: A holiday-themed scavenger hunt through Loop Campus offices where students collect treats and prizes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Holiday Cookie Stroll involves strolling through different offices in the Loop Campus to collect cookies and participate in activities.
cards.source_title: My Favorite Holiday Festivities At DePaul | DeBlogs
cards.access_notes: Held annually in December at the Loop Campus; check DeHUB for the starting location.

cards.title: The Face of DePaul
cards.subtitle: McCabe Hall Landmark
cards.notes: View the six-story mural of St. Vincent de Paul on McCabe Hall. It is composed of thousands of tiny faces, representing the diverse community of the university.
cards.short_summary: A massive wraparound mural of St. Vincent de Paul made of thousands of individual portraits.
cards.evidence_claim: The six-story wraparound mural of St. Vincent de Paul on McCabe Hall is made up of thousands of tiny faces.
cards.source_title: Two Minute Tour - St. Vincent de Paul Mural
cards.access_notes: Visible from the Fullerton 'L' station and Wish Field; accessible 24/7 for viewing.
